text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while I was working on my 
computer, Tosen Jordan came to visit...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Let me deck out your nails like crazy!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Never mind that! Here, give me your 
hand."
choice_data_list: No, exaggerating is a bit much...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Such a buzzkill! Come on, just a little 
bit won't hurt!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Guh...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...That's enough! See ya!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Did she have some sort of intention behind 
it? It weighed on my mind, but I had to 
finish my work first...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Nnnrgh! Nothing is going right at all!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I mean, aren't they way too serious?! At 
this rate, there's just no helping it—

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
My, is this handkerchief for me? What 
lovely embroidery... It's my favorite, 
cosmos flowers.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Wah, I'm glad! You mentioned that you 
liked it before♪ And a handkerchief won't 
get in the way of your outfits either.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Once again, happy birthday!

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! I'll treasure such a wonderful 
gift.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Buena-chan... whoa. The grown-ups are 
totally loving you, aren't they...!?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...And that's why my trainer totally 
refused to let me do fancy nails~.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, how do you make a serious impression 
on adults?! Or wait, do I just lack the 
claws for it entirely?!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
No, no, I think it's wonderful! Wanting to 
make your Trainer happy with your nails, 
that is.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I see. Nail art... for adults... 
Hmm."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Trainer, do you usually paint 
your nails?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...Nah, I dunno. I don't really watch 
it that much, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, in that case, hyping it up might not 
be a vibe. It's not like you're used to 
doing it.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Also, adults use their fingers a lot for 
paperwork and typing, right? In that case, 
what would be good for their nails is—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
!! Nail care, huh! Nails that won't crack 
or get hangnails even when doing that kind 
of work!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Buena-chan, you're seriously a god! You 
get adults on a spiritual level! Thanks a 
bunch!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
No, no, I didn't do anything! It was an 
idea born entirely from Jordan-san's 
desire to make you happy♪

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Feelings you've agonized over so earnestly 
will definitely get through. I'm rooting 
for you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The work I'd been doing since noon is 
finally finished. I wonder what Tosen 
Jordan is up to. Maybe I should go look 
for her—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, are you done with work? Ah... 
um, well, you see—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ~~gh, just do it! Show me your claws!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I won't exaggerate it, so come on, hand it 
over!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Nn... And that's the finishing touch. 
Well? The oil soaked in really well, 
don'tcha think?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Try typing on a computer for a bit. 
Doesn't it feel weird?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not only that, they're shining so brightly 
I barely recognize them. It's almost like 
they aren't even my own nails.
choice_data_list: Thank you, this feels really great!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ... That's my line.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...You've always done the exact same thing 
for me, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whenever things get really bad, she's 
there to help. Almost annoyingly so.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: And I'll take care of my nails, too.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't this crazy? *I'm* the one running 
with so much freedom...!?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
The fact that I can laugh like this right 
now!! And that I can sprint all-out in 
races!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...So, I mean... arghhh!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, how am I even supposed to say 
this!? So hard!!"
choice_data_list:
I got the message loud and clear... Thank 
you!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, how am I even supposed to say 
this!? So hard!!"
choice_data_list:
I got the message loud and clear... Thank 
you!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ngggh! Why'd you have to say it so 
casually~~...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Not fair! After all the agonizing I 
did!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Gimme your nails again! I'm gonna bedazzle 
the crap outta them after all~~~!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wait, you can tell? From just that? 
...Well, whatever, if you say so...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Aaaah~~! No killing the mood like this!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's hit a cafe once we're done! 
Your treat, got it?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, your eyes are all teary! Was it 
really that good!?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Well, looks like they really enjoyed 
it. Hmph—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Well, want me to do it for you again? Only 
if I feel like it, though!
